text.text_excerpt: Amazing! First of all I love Finn McCool's, it was one of my very favorite neighborhood bars when I lived in Mid City, but on top of that this place also has some of the best BBQ and bar food in all of NOLA. Everything on the menu is basically very creative takes on southern comfort food and dammit if it doesn't get the job done! My favorite item on the menu is the Big Easy Mac N' Cheesy: deep fried Mac n cheese ball, bacon, cheddar cheese and bookoo sauce. This burger will destroy your hunger and the thick cut fries that come along with it are some of the best fries you're likely to try in the city. You'll probably also run into the chef that created the menu while you're there, he hangs...

If you don't stop into Finn McCool's for anything else, a visit to Boo Koo BBQ is what you should be doing it for. The drink prices in the bar are great, the staff is stellar, the owners (Pauline & Steve) are heaven-sent, and the patrons are the friendliest and will make you feel at home, it's quite possibly my favorite bar in Mid City. Lee, the owner of Boo Koo is also one of the coolest people around. The menu items have got to be the best for curing any hangover, satisfying all munchies, and happen to be equally delicious even when you're 3rd-grade-sober. I love the fried macaroni n cheese with that bomb ass dipping sauce that comes with it, i've also had the loaded nachos (impressive)...

I put in a to-go order with Boo Koo today for lunch while I was checking out Finn McCool's. The food is seperate from the bar and you pay and order in the back of the pub. I ordered the fried truffle mac and cheese balls and a Galway burger (burger dressed with cheddar). Although I didn't eat the food until I was home 45 minutes later, it was delicious. The mac and cheese balls were crunchy but not greasy and came with an interesting and very tasty, tangy dipping sauce. My burger was delicious. The meat was seasoned wonderfully, cooked to perfection, and the chips (fries) were thick cut, seasoned, and crispy. My only complaint is a small one. They are cash only and I had to pay separately...
